description: This file defines the CoverBehavior class for Kivy, a UI framework, providing texture rendering with aspect ratio preservation, including example usage and Kivy language integration.

classes.name: CoverBehavior
classes.description: A Kivy mixin class that renders a texture covering the full widget size while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CoverBehavior, binding size and position changes to the calculate_cover method.

methods.name: _aspect_ratio_approximate
methods.description: Returns a decimal approximation of the aspect ratio of a given size.

methods.name: _scale_size
methods.description: Scales a size tuple based on a sizer tuple, maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: calculate_cover
methods.description: Calculates cover_size and cover_pos to fit the texture within the widget while preserving aspect ratio.
